exposure: Method of intracesarean postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion (manual vs. instrumental)
cohort: 100 women undergoing lower segment cesarean section
finding: Both manual and instrumental insertion of PPIUCD during cesarean section were found to be equally effective, with high continuation rates (94% and 92% respectively), minimal side effects, and no cases of infection, perforation, or contraceptive failure.
